interpretation.coordinates: Native loaded vertex buffers and native world matrices supply three near/far face-center pairs; every loaded anchor must be within the frozen 1 mm threshold. Bar lengths are reported without a new scale-error tolerance.
interpretation.audio: Four native sources remain running. The centered paired gains retain the frozen 0.1 dB balance gate. Outward and return traces require contiguous paired sample windows, native pose progress through every declared distance bin, positive source input, a decreasing distance-normalized fade envelope toward cutoff, and exactly zero pre-panner output for complete outside-cutoff windows. Reference-law residuals are diagnostics, not an invented additional numerical tolerance.
interpretation.timing: The audio clock controls measurement holds. Native keyboard-driven physics supplies the route; requested poses are not substituted for native listener readings. The declared one-second functional warmup is not execution of the separate F03 performance workload or its 60-second warmup and three 180-second samples.
interpretation.scope: Evaluation-only numerical browser measurements. They are not complete common-scenario, physical-audio, headset, performance, or A/V qualification. The existing 19 desktop, 10 emulated-XR and 9 portable checks remain separate.
